title: Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.16606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.

translated_title: 基于生成建模的变分鲁棒高斯过程回归
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16606v1 公告类型：新 摘要：由于高斯过程回归（GPR）采用传统的高斯观测似然函数，异常值会显著扭曲其性能，导致模型学习和预测不准确。为解决这一局限，本文引入一种生成式GPR模型，该模型能够捕获观测特有的污染并自适应地减轻异常值的影响。随后，采用变分广义期望最大化过程来学习潜在变量和GPR模型参数。在合成和真实数据集上，不同污染设置下的实验表明，所提方法在预测准确性方面与鲁棒GPR基线方法保持竞争力，并且在多种情况下表现更优。此外，所提方法具有与所比较GPR方法相同的三次方计算复杂度。
tldr: 本文提出一种生成式高斯过程回归模型，通过变分广义期望最大化自适应处理异常值，在保持计算复杂度的同时提升预测准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a generative Gaussian process regression model that adaptively handles outliers via variational generalized expectation-maximization, improving prediction accuracy while maintaining cubic computational complexity.
